title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a single centered card on an otherwise empty page. At the top of the card is the brand mark "ANDS Studio" with a small dot icon, then the heading "Sign in" and a one-line note beneath it: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." The form has two labeled fields — "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password". The primary button "Sign in →" stays disabled until both fields are filled; while submitting it reads "Working…". Beside it sits a secondary link-style button, "New client? Create a workspace", and below the row a smaller "Forgot password?" link. If sign-in fails, the raw error text appears in a red notice box above the buttons.

Clicking "New client? Create a workspace" swaps the same card into signup mode. The heading becomes "Create your workspace" with the note "One workspace per client company — dossiers, documents and filings stay isolated." A third field appears above Email: "Company / client name" (placeholder "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). Under the password field a hint reads "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers." The primary button is now "Create workspace →", with "Have an account? Sign in" to switch back.

Choosing "Forgot password?" shows the heading "Reset your password" and the instruction "Enter your account email. We issue a one-time code (expires in 15 minutes) to set a new password." You enter your email and click "Send me a code →". Because this environment has no email delivery, the code is displayed directly on screen in a notice: "Your one-time code (shown here because this environment has no email delivery):" followed by the code. Fields for "One-time code" (placeholder "8-digit code") and "New password" then appear; you click "Set new password →" or "Back to sign in". On success you're returned to the sign-in form with the message "Password updated — sign in with your new password."

After signing in or creating a workspace, you're taken to the dossier list (or to whatever protected page you originally tried to open). There, a small user chip shows your email and workspace name (e.g. bolded email "· Northbridge Regulatory CRO") with a ghost "Sign out" button that returns you to the login page. Any page you hit while signed out responds "sign in to access this workspace" and redirects here. To create your first dossier you'll need a Dossier ID in a specific format — one letter plus 6–7 digits — which the next screen enforces.
